name: Timberwell Berhad
overview: 2026年，Timberwell Berhad 通过认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 额外股份，将后者持股比例提升至78.09%，使其成为控股子公司；同时完成1拆3股票分割及5000万令吉资本削减。此外，公司收到 Quattrini Holdings 提出的无条件强制全面收购要约。
overview_en: In 2026, Timberwell Berhad increased its equity interest in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. to 78.09% via subscription of additional shares, making it a majority-owned subsidiary; it also completed a 1-for-3 share split and a RM50.0 million capital reduction. Additionally, the company received an unconditional mandatory take-over offer from Quattrini Holdings.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 额外14,750,000股普通股（10.77%股权），持股比例增至78.09%。
actions.text_en: Subscribed for an additional 14,750,000 ordinary shares (10.77% equity interest) in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd., increasing stake to 78.09%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以每股1.00令吉认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 14,750,000股新股，通过资本化应收款项支付，持股增至78.09%。
actions.text_en: Subscribed for 14,750,000 new shares in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. at RM1.00 per share, satisfied via capitalisation of quasi-equity, increasing stake to 78.09%.
